# loading libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rio)
library(ggplot2)
library(psych)
library(ggthemes)
library(summarytools)
library(tidyr)
library(formatR)
library(sjmisc)
library(caret)
library(report)
```
# loading data
```{r}
data2<-read.csv("diabetes.csv")
head(data2)
```
# check for missing values
```{r}
sum(is.na(data2))
```

# omit missing values
```{r}
omitted<-na.omit(data)
head(omitted)
```


# checking columns names
```{r}
names(data2)
```

# conversion ov variables to factor from both integer and character
```{r}
data2[c("diabetes", "hypertension", "heart_disease", "smoking_history")]<-lapply(
  c("diabetes", "hypertension", "heart_disease", "smoking_history"),
  function(v){
    if (v == "smoking_history") factor(data2[[v]])
    else factor(data2[[v]], levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
  }
)
```

# confirm for missing values
```{r}
colSums(is.na(data))
```

### check the frequency of diabetes case
```{r}

frq(data2, diabetes)
```


### visualize freq of diabetes case
```{r}
ggplot(data2, aes(x =diabetes, fill = diabetes)) +
   geom_bar(alpha = 0.7, color = "green") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = after_stat(count)),
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("No" = "#4c9", "Yes" = "#C03")) +
  labs(
    title = "Bar Plot of Diabetes Outcome",
    subtitle = paste0("Total observations: ", nrow(data)),
    x = "Diabetes",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Diabetes"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"   # redundant since x-axis already shows categories
  )
```
